node.statement: Scope discharge for the challenged inference. Write H for the additional assertion that c_0^cb is a fixed finite nonnegative universal constant. Node 1.1 proves the constant/radius ledger only under H, while node 1.1.2 establishes that H is not derivable from any definition or allowed external in this workspace. Hence the raw-refinement application can establish at most H implies the certified raw-call output; it cannot establish the unconditional root contract. The amended statement of node 1.6.2 now asserts exactly this conditional conclusion and explicitly leaves the unconditional root unproved, so no illicit discharge of H remains.
